The resource is intelligence: information that has been processed, placed in context, and converted into a decision within the window in which that decision still counts. items.summary: When the floodwaters rose around their home in Rajapul on July 19, Bandana Buragohain had no way of getting out on her own. A couple of other boys came and helped carry her to a nearby house with a terrace, where around 30 others had already taken shelter. “I somehow managed to stay alive. I could have died,” she recalled.
